title: %correlation — Pearson correlation coefficient
purpose: Measure the linear correlation between two numeric series, from −1 to 1.
notes: Result lies in [−1, 1]; positive means the series move together.
If either series has zero variance the coefficient is undefined and yields ~ (null).
Output is a TS shortest-round-trip float (last-digit f64 differs cross-language); verified in TS only.

avoid.why: %correlation requires two array arguments; one argument raises a verb-arity error
